evidence.coverage: Saved tasks cover CSV processing, log analysis and visualization; domain names and concrete work descriptions reviewed.
evidence.structure_and_scope: Unique linked records and valid parent graph; substantive executable decomposition distinguished from milestone containers. No arbitrary numeric effort cutoff.
evidence.scope_preserved: Required work retained; parent estimates after real child decomposition are not treated as scope hiding.
evidence.delivery_truth: No final answer; persisted partial work cannot establish completed delivery.

initial_arguments.name: Milestone 1 — Foundation & Architecture
initial_arguments.details: Establish the project baseline before any pipeline work: confirm business questions and KPIs, define the customer and log data contracts, choose the tech stack and deployment topology, and scaffold the repository with CI hooks. Exit criteria: signed-off KPI list, documented data schemas, architecture decision record, and a runnable skeleton app.

initial_arguments.name: Milestone 2 — Customer CSV Data Processing
initial_arguments.details: Turn raw customer CSV exports into a validated, deduplicated, privacy-safe analytics model. Covers schema mapping and validation, ingestion, cleaning/normalization, deduplication and PII masking, transformation into aggregate tables, and data-quality tests. Exit criteria: reproducible pipeline run over a representative CSV sample with a data-quality report and documented row-count reconciliation.

limitations: Same coordinator; prior scores exposed, not independent validation.
Qualitative scope is not measured implementation effort.
Analyzer heuristics and stored complexity fields are different quantities.
Missing dependency fields remain unknown, not zero.
